description:
inline_dispatch_input_demands (src/compiler2/jobs/runtime_demand.rs) starts every handed subject at RuntimeDemand::whole(), so a rest bound in a case arm is built on every step whatever the arm does with it. A 10,240-byte walk written with case makes 10,175 bitstring allocations and 65 off-heap binaries; written with clauses it makes none.

Change: the parameter's own demand decides. An arm that only walks its rest receives two lanes; an arm that returns, sends or stores it asks for it whole and receives one lane, built once.

Removed, fully: the Whole floor for a handed rest and its comments (runtime_demand.rs ~2207-2211, ~2246-2248); the sentences in .agent/docs/pipeline.md ("...until something reads it whole; an outcome argument is always handed to its arm whole") and .agent/docs/dispatch-matrix.md ("An arm takes its parameters as whole values, so a handed subject is always read whole"). Whether the floor can go for every handed subject, not only a rest, is to be established here; if it can, it goes.

Expected lowering of the case walk: no BitReadField with a rest spec on the looping path; the arm entry takes (source, position, c).

Predictions: case-walk probe 0 bitstring allocations and 0 off-heap binaries on interp, run and build; clause walk stays 0; distiller flat; pins same or lower. Add a fixture that walks a binary through a case arm and pins its allocations on three paths.

Done when: the probe is 0/0 on three paths, the rule is gone from code and docs, gate green.

Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.cursor-fold.html (approved by the user 2026-11-15: remove special cases; what is no longer needed is fully removed).

From fz-sc8.228 as built: a Branch parameter's layout comes from its own demand through the transport plan, replacing the whole_value_layout fill for Branch entries. Known cost to settle before building: a Value position per outcome parameter added 206 requests to the distill pin (50522 -> 50728). First establish whether the layout can be read off the subject the parameter aliases (TransportOrigin::OutcomeSubject) without a position of its own; a pin rise needs the user's authorization with the measured compile cost. Known effects beyond the rest: an exact tuple handed to an arm travels as lanes, and a parameter nobody reads is zero lanes; each needs its own prediction and fixture check.
title: A rest handed to a case arm arrives the way the arm reads it
